$comment: Read by tools/ci/testGate.mjs. See CLAUDE.md section 7.
criticalSuites: must load, run at least one test, never fail and never skip. They can never appear in knownFailures or expectedSkips.

knownFailures: exact test names, each with an owner and an expiry at most 45 days after it was added. The gate fails when an entry expires or its test stops failing, so the list only shrinks. Adding an entry needs the user's explicit approval.

expectedSkips: tests that skip in a clean checkout because the private database (server/data/recruitmatch.sqlite) is absent. Regenerate with: node tools/ci/testGate.mjs <vitest.json> --print-skips, and review the diff. Any other skip fails CI.
